values.note: Book through the park manager (780-842-3541, middlemass@wainwright.ca); the camping permit is prepaid at registration to guarantee the booking. Reserved sites are held until 7 pm on the arrival day, then charged one night. Cancel 24 hours ahead or pay one night. Check-out noon.

note: Town of Wainwright campground at 1504 8 Ave, in town beside the Rotary Splash Park. The park's rules bar trucks over one tonne and all off-highway vehicles. --Claude
summary: Town page and the town's 2025 brochure read: 30 full-service 30 A sites + 4 15 A tent stalls, showers, Wi-Fi by login; RV C$38.85 a night (C$233.10 weekly) GST included; booking through the manager by phone/email. Added fees, booking platform phone, wifi; 'reservable online' in the old note is unsupported (campreservations.ca now redirects to Campspot's home page; no Campspot listing found). Season left derived (no source states it). Note cleaned.
flags: VEHICLE RULE (for the human): brochure '4. Motor Vehicles - Only vehicles licensed for highways may be operated on roadways within Parks and Recreation areas. No trucks over 1-tonne are permitted within the park limits.' A motorhome is not a truck on its face; reported in case the rule is read as a weight limit.
PRICE: C$38.85 a night incl. GST from the town's brochure (PDF dated Jun 10, 2025) - a 2025 rate; no 2026 rate posted. Local campground (no C$69 private gate); under it anyway.

BOOKING: the old note's 'reservable online' and the inclusion evidence's 'campreservations.ca booking page' no longer hold: campreservations.ca redirects to www.campspot.com (CloudFront 403 to plain fetch) and four Campspot slug guesses returned 422. The town page and brochure give phone/email booking only.
